AI-assisted machine review limited to structural verification: complete key coverage in DEFAULT_STRINGS order, exact placeholders, ICU syntax and the pinned CLDR cardinal categories (few, one, other) were checked, and each of the 66 English-identical messages was inspected and given an entry-specific rationale. 2026-11-16 bounded independent AI-assisted review examined the ten additions across all 80 supported source locale IDs for inclusive limits, optional zero-or-one selection, displayed versus total actions, current versus earlier document batches, retention and restart meaning, locale script, neighboring terminology and placeholders. Reviewed corrections cover Irish noun number, Tagalog demonstrative scope, Burmese loading vocabulary, Tamil suffix attachment, Pashto maximum-bound wording, Sindhi earlier-history wording, and number-neutral Arabic and Russian phrases. Regional inheritance and the Portuguese overrides were inspected. Approval covers only this delta; earlier messages, plural branches and rendered mixed-direction behavior were not re-audited. Technical idiom remains subject to fluent-speaker refinement, especially in lower-resource languages. No human or native-speaker certification is claimed.
